The studio FORMA is a 12-person creative studio working at the intersection of strategy and craft. We partner with ambitious companies to define and build their visual identity — from first sketch to final pixel. Our process is collaborative, fast, and built around results that outlast the trend cycle. 140+ clients served 6 years running 23 awards won 3 studio locations 01 Brand Strategy Positioning, messaging architecture, competitive landscape analysis, and naming. 02 Visual Identity Logo systems, colour, typography, iconography, and full brand guidelines. 03 Digital Experience Website design and development, interactive prototypes, and motion systems. 04 Campaign & Content Campaign concepting, art direction, social content, and print collateral.
